The error burst began at **`2026-01-18T03:17:42Z`** on host **`api-07`**, with the log line:

ERROR api-07 db pool exhausted (max=20) waiting=14 path=/v1/orders

## (2) The root cause

The database connection pool was **fully consumed by the batch job**, leaving zero connections for the API services. The pool `max=20`, and the batch job acquired all 20 connections one-by-one (one every ~5 seconds), holding them the entire time. All api-XX processes trying to reach the database during that window got 503 "db pool exhausted" errors.
